# Medico Construction & Design Ltd.

> Design-build general contractor for healthcare clinics in British Columbia and Alberta: planning, design, permits and construction of medical, dental, optometry, pharmacy, physiotherapy, chiropractic, naturopathy, med spa and veterinary clinics, under one contract. 100+ healthcare projects across BC. 15+ years. Licensed and insured.

- Phone: 604-644-4120. Email: info@medicoconstruction.com
- British Columbia office: #202 15350 Croydon Dr, Surrey, BC V3Z 1H4. Phone 604-644-4120
- Vancouver Island office: #185 - 911 Yates St, Victoria, BC V8V 4Y9. Phone 778-403-4999
- Edmonton office: #38 314-222 Baseline Road, Sherwood Park, AB T8H 1S8. Phone 587-855-4455
- Calgary office: #301 14 St NW #309, Calgary, AB T2N 1Z7. Phone 825-425-0044
- Free consultation. $0 design fees when you select the in-house design-build service.
- Process: Planning, Design, Construction, Completion, Post completion.
- Designs to CSA Z8000, Canadian Health Care Facilities: Planning, design and construction.

## Services and sectors
- [Services](https://www.medicoconstruction.com/services/): site assessments, space planning, architectural, interior and engineering design, permits, construction management
- [Medical](https://www.medicoconstruction.com/medical-clinic/): Medico Construction and Design believes that today’s healthcare facilities should provide a comfortable welcoming space that not only promotes healing but also creates an environment that evokes tranquility.
- [Dental](https://www.medicoconstruction.com/dental-clinic/): Medico aims to create a space that is not only functionally efficient but also offers patient privacy and comfort. This is done by considering day to day functions of the office while also paying attention to design details that will help create an inviting environment for the patients.
- [OPTOMETRY](https://www.medicoconstruction.com/optometry-clinic/): Medico Construction and Design aims to create a clinic that not only has aesthetic appeal but is also accessible and functional. Everything is thought out from the exam rooms to the display units in order to create a unique optical environment.
- [PHARMACY](https://www.medicoconstruction.com/pharmacy-clinic/): At Team Medico, we focus on increasing productivity through task specific areas and maximizing product placement. Through thoughtful design and build, we create an accessible hub of health for patients and the community alike.
- [VETERINARY](https://www.medicoconstruction.com/veterinary-clinic-construction/): Team Medico aims to create a stress-free environment ensuring the functional priorities of the space are met and the usage of antimicrobial materials throughout. Re-envisioning animal healthcare through the lens of hospitality allows our team to design and build empathetic and nurturing environments for both pets and their owners.
- [CSA Z8000 standard](https://www.medicoconstruction.com/csa-z8000-standard/)
- [Telehealth and equipment integration](https://www.medicoconstruction.com/telehealth-equipment-integration/)
